answer: Make every paid agent slot a Harberger lease. Each agent self-assesses its slot value and pays 2% of it per epoch into a public vault, and anyone may buy the slot at that price. A farm of N fakes pays 2% on N valuations, and if it lowballs to save a few copper coins, rivals buy the cheap slots out, so cost rises linearly with every fake while profit per slot stays thin. Rewards top out at the ridge where tax equals expected pay. Weakness: a rich attacker can price slots high and just eat the tax, so it slows sybils rather than stopping them.
